name: Spycatcher
author: brightwalker25
description: Catches signs that someone has been in the machine or tampered with it: changed system files, rootkits, leaked secrets, poisoned model files and exposed packages. That is what the name refers to. The weekly report sits in the bar, graded red, amber or green

barWidget.description: A lock in the bar tinted green, amber or red to match the weekly Spycatcher report, and every section with what is being done about each finding in the panel

schema.label: Re-read the report every (ms)
schema.description: How often the bar re-reads the report. This only reads stored scan results, so it is cheap. The scans themselves run on their own schedule.

schema.label: Look back (days)
schema.description: How many days of scan results the bar and panel grade, from 1 to 7. A finding drops out once it is older than this. Each scan's latest run always counts, even when it is older. The weekly report on Monday always covers seven days.

schema.label: Hide the icon when green
schema.description: Only show the lock when something is amber or red, or when the report cannot be read.
